meta.description: Hangs gills under a cap where a pattern has stripes: every stripe of reaction_diffusion becomes a gill that forks and starts between others where the stripes do. Thin plates like Agaricus, or with blunt the low rounded folds (false gills) of a chanterelle. Connect the stipe and set decurrent and the gills run on down it. Gives every gill as thin paths stacked from the cap underside down to the gill edge, to mesh with the rest, and as a mesh, which keeps plates thin and folds blunt at any mesh resolution.

cap.description: The rays of a cap node, the gills hang from their underside and follow them when they move

hinge.description: The hinge of the cap node: where the cap sits and how thick the stipe is

pattern.description: Stripes around the axis, every stripe becomes a gill. Its radius is the distance along the cap underside from the axis.

stipe.description: The stipes the caps sit on, for gills that run down them (decurrent)

depth.description: How far the gills reach down from the cap underside where they are deepest. Read for every stipe, so it can follow the size of each mushroom.

depth_curve.label: Depth to the margin
depth_curve.description: How deep the gills are from the stipe (left) to the margin (right), as a share of the depth

free_distance.description: Gap between the gills and the stipe, Agaricus gills are free

decurrent.description: How far the gills that reach the stipe run on down it, lower and lower until they are gone. Needs the stipe and a free distance of 0. Read for every stipe, so it can follow the size of each mushroom.

thickness.description: Thickness of a gill where it leaves the cap, the width of a blunt fold. Read for every stipe, so it can follow the size of each mushroom.

blunt.description: 0 = thin plates with a sharp edge (true gills), 1 = low folds with a round back, never deeper than the thickness (false gills of Cantharellus)

edge_wave.description: How much the gill edges wave, sideways and up and down. 0 = straight edges, 1 = waves a third of the gill spacing wide
